units.source_text: “阿芳发现新的干松鱼后，就把它拿到老板娘那儿去了。

en.t: When Afang found the new dried bonito, she took it to the innkeeper's wife.

units.source_text: 据阿芳说，老板娘正在削干松鱼，就叫阿芳拿它去跟新的对换，她说着把干松鱼尾巴交给了阿芳。

en.t: According to Afang, the innkeeper's wife was shaving the dried bonito, so she told Afang to take it and exchange it for the new one, and as she said this she handed Afang the tail end of the bonito.

units.source_text: 听这么一说，我再也不能在这儿待下去了。”

en.t: When I heard that, I could no longer stay there.
